name: amfx-uk-retail-sales-rolling-sum
description: amFX reproduction (20JAN23 p1): 6-month rolling sum of UK MoM retail sales (1988-2022). Bar chart showing extreme negative reading in late 2022 at GFC-level lows. 2020-2021 removed to avoid COVID y-axis dilation. FRED series GBRSLRTTO01GPSAM (OECD UK Retail Trade Volume, Growth Rate Previous Period). Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: 6-MONTH ROLLING SUM OF UK MOM RETAIL SALES (20JAN23 p1)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's chart showing UK retail sales at historically extreme
# negative levels. In 6% inflation, negative NOMINAL retail sales implies
# ~12% real drop. Current reading comparable only to 2008/2009 GFC.
# 2020-2021 data removed to avoid COVID distortion of the y-axis.
#
# FRED series: GBRSLRTTO01GPSAM
# = Sales: Retail Trade: Total Retail Trade: Volume for United Kingdom
# = Growth rate previous period (month-over-month), seasonally adjusted

# =============================================================================

# Fetch UK retail sales MoM % change (monthly frequency on daily grid)
mom_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GBRSLRTTO01GPSAM')()

# Detect release days
had_release = is_valid(mom_src.result)

# Replace NaN with 0 for rolling sum computation
# On non-release days, contribution is 0; on release days, it's the MoM value
mom_clean = coalesce(mom_src.result, 0.0)

# Rolling 6-month sum (~132 trading days covers 6 monthly observations)
rolling_6m = sum(period=132)(mom_clean)

# Only show bar values on release days (NaN elsewhere)
release_mask = mom_src.result / mom_src.result
rolling_release = rolling_6m * release_mask

# Exclude 2020-2021 COVID period: set to NaN
idx = index()
year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(idx)
is_covid = (year >= 2020) and (year <= 2021)
rolling_display = rolling_release if not is_covid else 0.0 / 0.0

# Create YYYYMM label for x-axis (NaN on non-release / COVID days)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(idx)
yymm_label_raw = year * 100 + month_num
nan_mask = rolling_display / rolling_display
yymm_label = yymm_label_raw * nan_mask

# =============================================================================
# CHART: 6-Month Rolling Sum of MoM UK Retail Sales
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='UK Retail Sales: How Bad Is the Current Slump?',
    category='UK Retail Sales',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=False,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='6-Month Rolling Sum (MoM %)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='6M Rolling Sum', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=rolling_display, label=yymm_label)
